about: Switches the Leonida Launcher offers as drop-downs. The launcher downloads this file from the main branch, so a new switch shows up without a launcher release.
name: the switch without LEONIDA_. values: the choices besides default (default sets nothing). about: shown on hover. build: the branch a switch needs while it is not on main, empty once merged.

switches.name: DLSS
switches.about: NVIDIA DLSS upscaling on RTX cards. Needs the DLSS files from scripts\get-nvidia-dlss.ps1.

switches.name: THIN
switches.about: Thinner work in the submit queue line.

switches.name: WC_NO_BACK
switches.about: Skips copying large write-combined buffers back to the CPU.

switches.name: WAVE_MORE_SKIPS
switches.about: More branch skips in 32-lane shaders, a try at the dark water diamonds. Warm up shaders after changing it.

switches.name: TEXTURE_STAGE_MB
switches.about: Texture staging size in MB. 8 GB cards: try 512.
